text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (This race is mine to win!!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Told ya so, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're gonna get way more than just burned, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Tamamo Cross breaks through!
Tamamo Cross takes the lead! Tamamo Cross in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(A-Amazing...!!
So this is the "White Lightning"...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!
The Takarazuka Kinen is mine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...――

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, heheh...
My legs are still trembling...
Seriously, what an incredible run that was...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You ran a great race too, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta hand it to ya, that grit of yours, never givin' up on tryin' to beat me right to the bitter end, was somethin' else.
Thanks to that—I've gotten even stronger."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: If we get the chance, let's do it again.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: âAnd when that time comes, I'll blow right past 'em too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Tama, you were right. I definitely didn't get off with just a minor burn. Right now, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "I got all fired up...! From watching your running and that sheer greed of yours up close...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's still far off right now... I'll definitely
step into the exact same realm as you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The one who'll roar at next year's Takarazuka Kinen... will be none other than Lady Inari herself!
